ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white pixels (rosettes) to low-intensity dark pixels (background) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity dark gray/black background across both lobes, populated with discrete high-intensity white circular ring clusters concentrated near the tips and dispersed across the central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with well-defined interior vertices.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations exhibiting sharp peaks and jagged valleys along the continuous boundary of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature fitted to the outer edges of both lobes extending from the median notch to the tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density population of white circular ring-like clusters (rosettes) distributed globally across the dark pigmentation of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (possible rake marks) visible on the mid-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acquired scarring from barnacle colonization manifesting as white circular pixel clusters across the entire visible ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast texture created by the extreme density of white rosette scars against a uniform dark fluke base.
